name: gptadmin
description: GPTAdmin: searchable, profile-scoped tools and compact JavaScript operations.

interface.shortDescription: OAuth MCP hub with searchable tools and JavaScript operations.
interface.longDescription: Installing GPTAdmin adds a remote OAuth-protected MCP server. On first connection the Hub opens a browser consent page where the user enters the admin password; the password and bearer tokens never belong in Codex chat or plugin files. GPTAdmin exposes a client-independent, profile-scoped facade: search visible tools and settings, run short JavaScript operations, manage servers and child MCPs, and inspect operation receipts.
defaultPrompt: Connect to GPTAdmin through its OAuth browser flow.
Search caller-visible tools and settings, then use code_exec for operations.
Use discover and schema only as read-only compatibility tools.
Install or use a child MCP through GPTAdmin search and code_exec.
Use the memory MCP named by the active GPTAdmin profile.
